title: PHP2Shell: the attack can start before your code runs
description:
PHP released 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35 on 21 October 2026 to fix two critical flaws, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution.

From the php.net security advisory: "We consider the risk highest for mod_php, with a demonstrated exploit where an unauthenticated request can trigger the attack before any application code runs." And from the release notes: "There are no complete mitigations, updating is the only safe choice."

Sources:
https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5
https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-4

Narrated with an AI voice. Sound effects only, no music.
